title: Te Ariki i Whakawhiti i ngā Pito o te Ao
intro: Whakaarohia tētahi rangatira kaha, i whakawhiwhia ki te kaha me te mana whakahaere mō te whenua. I tīmata tēnei tangata i ngā haerenga whakamiharo, i tae atu ki te wāhi e torengi ai te rā me te wāhi e whiti ai, i tūtaki ki ngā iwi tauhou, ā, i tūtaki ki tētahi wero nui mai i ngā iwi kino e rua. Ko wai tēnei rangatira ngaro?
clues: He rangatira ahau i whakawhiwhia ki te mana me ngā tikanga hei toro atu ki ngā pito rawa o te ao.
I haere ahau ki te hauauru, ā, i kite ahau i te tōnga o te rā i roto i te puna pouri.
I tūtaki ahau ki tētahi iwi e tata ana ki te rā e whiti ana, kāore nei ō rātou piringa i tōna werawera.
I tono mai tētahi atu hapori ki ahau kia āwhina i a rātou ki te whawhai ki ngā iwi pirau e rua e mōhiotia nei ko Koka rāua ko Makoka.
I hanga e au he ārai mā te whakamahi i te rino me te parahi rewa hei pupuri i a rātou.
I kī atu ahau he tohu aroha tēnei ārai nā tōku Ariki, ā, ka mau tonu ki te wā kua whakaritea.

arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
verse: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?" (18:94)
